straight.label: Straight
straight.note: Original long locks retained; mismatched exposed temple backing removed.

twin-braids.label: Twin braids
twin-braids.note: Full plaits rest against the selected top; the original roots remain independently fitted.

sidepart.label: Crop
sidepart.note: Crop: crown-to-front flow with slight diagonal drift, varied rounded fringe clumps and shorter sides.

taper.label: Taper
taper.note: Shorter rounded side banks; upper sweep retained. Curved directional fade detail uses214 as the reference.

buzz.label: Buzz
buzz.note: Near-bald close cut with a clean, bounded hairline and dense fine surface texture.

curly-top.label: Curly top
curly-top.note: Retained curly crown with the same curved directional side treatment as Taper.

afro.label: Afro
afro.note: Compact rounded silhouette with dense irregular coil texture.

flow.label: Flow
flow.note: Continuous sculpted growth with a shifted part, ear-covering length and softer curved ends.

locs.label: Locs
locs.note: Short, consistent loc sections with rounded ends and a gathered root surface.

middle-part.label: Middle part
middle-part.note: Rooted center-part banks with continuous crown coverage.
